description: Verify that DUT-emitted ARP Announcements have Ethernet destination = broadcast (FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF) (RFC 3927 §2.4, MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
RFC 3927 §2.4 says Announcements (the post-claim gratuitous ARPs declaring 'I now own this LL') MUST be sent as link-layer broadcast — every host on the segment must update its ARP cache with the new owner. This case observes the first DUT-emitted Announcement and asserts Ethernet dst is broadcast.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (kicks the Link-Local state machine)

2. DUT: 3 Probes → 1st Announce.

3. Observation:
   • DUT → wire: ARP Announcement
     - Ethernet dst = FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted Announcement has Ethernet dst = broadcast.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_announce_eth_dst_not_broadcast — Announcement Ethernet dst is not broadcast
• Fail_no_announce_after_probes — DUT did not emit any Announcement after the Probe phase

verdicts.Fail_announce_eth_dst_not_broadcast: Announcement Ethernet destination is not broadcast
verdicts.Fail_no_announce_after_probes: DUT did not emit any ARP Announcement after Probes
